_note: Every piece of UI text (G-30). Keys are flat and dotted; {name} is a placeholder; plurals use .one / .other keys read by tn().

strings.app.title: Grand Strategy
strings.app.phaseNote: Phase 1 preview: the map, your country's budget and the monthly report. War, resources and diplomacy come next.
strings.app.noscript: This game needs JavaScript. Please turn it on and reload the page.
strings.app.screenFailed: That screen could not be shown, so you are back at the title screen.
strings.app.bootFailed.title: The game could not start
strings.app.bootFailed.body: Some game files could not be loaded. Check your connection once, then try again.
strings.common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
strings.title.storageMemory: Saving is not available in this browser mode. You can still play and export saves, but they will be lost when you close the page.
strings.title.install.title: Install this app
strings.title.install.ios: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
strings.title.offline.pending: Preparing offline play… keep this page open for a moment.
strings.title.offline.unsupported: Offline play is not supported in this browser.
strings.title.offline.file: Works offline: everything is inside this file.
strings.title.singleFile: This is a downloaded copy. It runs without a connection but cannot be installed as an app. To install, open the web link instead.
strings.map.title: Middle East
strings.map.failed: The map could not be shown: {error}
strings.map.hint: Drag to move, pinch to zoom, tap a country.
strings.map.panel.notPlayableBody: The rest of the world is drawn in grey so you can see where things are. It opens for play in a later phase.
strings.play.hint: Open Budget to set taxes and spending, then tap End turn.
strings.play.autosaveFailed: Autosave failed. Open Saves and export your game to be safe.
strings.play.turnFailed.title: The turn failed
strings.play.turnFailed.body: Something went wrong, so your game was put back to the start of this turn. Nothing is lost. Please copy the details and send them to me.
strings.play.menu.title: Menu
strings.play.quit.title: Quit to the title screen?
strings.play.quit.body: Your progress is autosaved every turn. Anything since the last turn is lost.
strings.pick.title: Choose your country
strings.pick.hint: Tap a country on the map or in the list, then play.
strings.report.title: Monthly report
strings.report.heading: Report: {date}
strings.report.empty: No report yet. End the turn to see how the month went.
strings.report.tapHint: Tap a line to see how it is worked out.
strings.alert.borrowing: The treasury is empty. Next month the state must borrow {amountMn} to pay its bills.
strings.alert.runway.one: At this rate the treasury is empty in about {n} month.
strings.alert.runway.other: At this rate the treasury is empty in about {n} months.
strings.alert.debt: Debt is {percent}% of GDP. Interest costs {interestMn} a month.
strings.budget.title: Budget
strings.budget.subtitle: Standing orders for {name}
strings.budget.surplus: This pays for itself. A surplus repays debt first, then fills the treasury.
strings.budget.deficit: A shortfall is paid from the treasury first, then borrowed.
strings.news.economy.borrowing: The treasury ran dry. The state borrowed {amountMn} to pay its bills.
strings.news.economy.solvent: The treasury is paying its own way again.
strings.saves.title: Saves
strings.saves.delete.title: Delete {slot}?
strings.saves.import.title: Import into which slot?
strings.saves.import.body: Pick a slot for the imported game. A slot that already has a game will be replaced.
strings.saves.dataMismatch: This save was made with different game data, so it may behave differently.
strings.saves.error.bad_slot: That save slot does not exist.
strings.saves.error.write_failed: Could not write the save. Your device may be out of space, or storage is blocked.
strings.saves.error.read_failed: Could not read the saves. Storage may be blocked.
strings.saves.error.bad_file: That file is not a readable save from this game.
strings.saves.error.too_new: That save was made by a newer version of the game. Update the app first.
strings.saves.error.too_old: That save is from the early test version, which had no countries, so it cannot be continued. Start a new game.
strings.saves.error.migration_missing: That save is too old to open.
strings.saves.error.migration_failed: That save could not be upgraded.
strings.saves.error.storage_unavailable: Saving is not available in this browser mode.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.notSaved: Applied for now, but this device would not store the setting.
strings.settings.textSize.title: Text size
strings.settings.textSize.sample: Sample: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
strings.settings.map.title: Map
strings.settings.map.body: The whole world is drawn in grey around the Middle East. If the map feels slow on your phone, choose Middle East only. The change applies the next time you open the map.
strings.settings.updates.title: Updates
strings.settings.updates.unsupported: Updates are not supported in this browser.
strings.settings.updates.error: Could not check. Are you offline?
strings.settings.updates.ready: A new version is ready. Tap Reload on the notice to use it.
strings.settings.updates.installing: A new version is downloading. You will be told when it is ready.
strings.settings.updates.file: This is a downloaded copy and cannot update itself. To get a newer version, download the file again.
strings.settings.erase.title: Erase saves
strings.settings.erase.body: Deletes every autosave and every saved game on this device.
strings.settings.erase.confirmBody: Every autosave and saved game on this device will be deleted. Export anything you want to keep first.
strings.diag.title: Diagnostics
strings.diag.intro: A health check of this device. Tap “Copy report” and paste it into the chat so I can see how the game runs on your phone.
